messages:
Maria: kicking off canary for model v2.1.3 -> 10% in eu-west. will watch metrics for 30m. pinging SRE/eng for visibility.

deploy-bot: rollout started: v2.1.3 -> 10% (eu-west). rollout_id=dpl-4132109999. watch: https://console/redwood/rollouts/dpl-4132109999

Oliver: noticed a small shift in summary token length on the sample set — not infra errors, but summaries are ~30% longer on average. sending a couple examples.

Oliver: ```
input: "Summarize the user's request"
v2.1.2 -> "Short summary."
v2.1.3 -> "A more elaborate summary that adds extra context and a multi-sentence explanation which wasn't requested."
```

Jamie: that's going to affect downstream UX. quality regression even if latency ok.

Aj: can we hold at 10% until we triage? I'd prefer pinning eu-west back to v2.1.2 if the regression reproduces.

SRE-Oncall: infra signals stable. cpu/gpu/mem all normal. no spike in 5xx. latency steady.

Maria: ok — putting a hard hold at 10% for eu-west. request stop/go: HOLD. do we want rollback or regional pin?

deploy-bot: rollout paused by request (actor=Maria). rollout_id=dpl-4132109999. status=PAUSED

Oliver: regression looks consistent on our eval prompts. would prefer pin for eu-west and continue staged rollout in other regions after a rollback patch.

Jamie: agree with pin. also add a note to release notes and flag this in the perf/regression playbook.

Aj: on it. running pin command now: `deployctl pin --region=eu-west --version=v2.1.2 --reason="summary-length-regression"`

deploy-bot: pin applied: region=eu-west -> v2.1.2. pin_id=pin-4132110042. traffic reverted in eu-west.

Maria: nice. please also open a small rollback/change PR that documents the observed diffs + example prompts so we can triage model tuning. link it here when ready.

Oliver: creating PR and adding a small eval job. PR: https://git.redwood/infra/rollouts/pull/542

Jamie: updating release notes draft and adding a "reverted in eu-west" line + notes for QE.

Aj: done. I left a short runbook note and set alert threshold tighter for summary token growth.

SRE-Oncall: monitoring watch is still green. no additional action from infra.

Maria: thanks everyone. we'll keep the overall deployment paused until the fixes land. continuing analysis in the PR thread. :thumbsup:

Oliver: +1. let's reconvene after the PR merges and a small internal eval run (target ~2h).

deploy-bot: reminder scheduled: `rollout-review` in 2h for dpl-4132109999.

Jamie: ack.
